name: PassPass Events Ticketing Plugin
author: PassPass

sections.description:
Transform Your WordPress Site Into a Complete Event Management Platform

PassPass Events is the ultimate WordPress plugin for event organizers who want a professional ticketing and event management solution without the complexity of traditional WordPress event plugins.

Perfect for:
* Existing PassPass Users: Seamlessly display your events and sell tickets directly on your WordPress website
* Event Organizers: Looking for a powerful alternative to WP Event Manager, The Events Calendar, or custom event solutions
* Businesses & Organizations: Need professional event management with integrated ticketing and registration

Unlike complex WordPress event plugins that require extensive setup, PassPass Events connects your site to a complete event management platform, giving you professional ticketing, registration, and event promotion tools out of the box.

Complete Ticketing Solution:
* Secure Payment Processing: Accept payments directly through your events
* Automatic Ticket Generation: Professional PDF tickets sent automatically
* Real-time Availability: Live ticket stock management and sales tracking
* Customer Management: Built-in attendee database and communication tools
* QR Code Integration: Digital tickets with secure QR codes for entry validation
* Multi-currency Support: Sell tickets in your local currency

Made in Belgium 🇧🇪 – Proudly developed by PassPass, your trusted European event management partner.

Key Features:
Available in French (FR), Dutch (NL), and English (EN)

  • Professional Event Display: Automatic integration via PassPass API
  • Ticket Sales Integration: Direct booking and payment processing
  • Multiple Layouts: Grid, list, or minimal display options
  • Complete Visual Customization: Colors, fonts, card styles
  • Event Management: Hide/show events, manage visibility
  • Responsive Design: Perfect on all devices and screen sizes
  • Custom CSS Support: Add your own styles with absolute priority
  • Theme Compatibility: Automatic light/dark theme support
  • Built-in Analytics: Click tracking and event statistics
  • Performance Optimized: Smart caching for fast loading
  • Multilingual Support: Available in French (FR), Dutch (NL), and English (EN)
  • No Complex Setup: Works immediately without complicated configuration

Why Choose PassPass Events Over Other WordPress Event Plugins?

  • No Vendor Lock-in: Unlike WP Event Manager or The Events Calendar, your events are managed through PassPass’s professional platform
  • Complete Ticketing Solution: Built-in payment processing, ticket generation, and customer management
  • Zero Setup Time: No need to configure payment gateways, email systems, or complex event forms
  • Professional Features: Advanced analytics, automated emails, attendee management, and more

Easy Setup:

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Configure your PassPass Organization ID
  3. Use the [passpass_events] shortcode wherever you want
  4. Customize the appearance from the administration interface

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to function properly. Here’s what data is sent and when:

PassPass API
* Purpose: Retrieve your event information for display on your website
* Data sent: Your PassPass Organization ID (configured in plugin settings)
* When: Every time events are displayed on your site (cached for 15 minutes by default)

Firebase Storage (firebasestorage.googleapis.com)
* Purpose: Load event images hosted on PassPass’s image storage service
* Data sent: No personal data – only loads public event images
* When: When displaying events that contain images
* Privacy Policy: https://firebase.google.com/policies/privacy

Support

For any questions or technical support, contact us via:
* Website: https://pro.passpass.be?utm_source=wordpress-org&utm_medium=plugin-directory&utm_campaign=passpass-events-plugin&utm_content=support
* Email: contact@passpass.be

Additional Info

This plugin connects to PassPass services to retrieve your events. No personal data is transmitted, only public events are displayed.

Privacy policy: https://pro.passpass.be/politique-de-confidentialite?utm_source=wordpress-org&utm_medium=plugin-directory&utm_campaign=passpass-events-plugin&utm_content=privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Download and activate the plugin
  2. Go to “PassPass Events” in your administration menu
  3. Configure your Organization ID PassPass (required)
  4. Customize the appearance according to your needs
  5. Use the [passpass_events] shortcode in your pages/posts

Required Configuration:
* A PassPass account with created events (free to create at https://pro.passpass.be?utm_source=wordpress-org&utm_medium=plugin-directory&utm_campaign=passpass-events-plugin&utm_content=required-config)
* Your PassPass Organization ID

New to PassPass? Create your free account and create your first event to get started with professional event management and ticketing.
sections.faq:
Where can I find my PassPass Organization ID?

Log in to your PassPass dashboard at https://pro.passpass.be?utm_source=wordpress-org&utm_medium=plugin-directory&utm_campaign=passpass-events-plugin&utm_content=organization-id and retrieve your Organization ID from your account settings.

Is the plugin free?

Yes, PassPass Events is completely free and will always remain so.

Can I customize the appearance?

Absolutely! The plugin offers many customization options: colors, fonts, card styles, layouts, and even custom CSS.

Do events update automatically?

Yes, events are automatically synchronized with your PassPass account. An intelligent cache system ensures optimal performance.

Can I hide certain events?

Yes, you can manage the visibility of each event individually from the administration interface.

How does this compare to other WordPress event plugins?

Unlike traditional WordPress event plugins that require complex setup, PassPass Events connects to a complete event management platform. You get professional ticketing, payment processing, and attendee management without the hassle of configuring multiple plugins and services.

Do I need a PassPass account?

Yes, you need a PassPass account to use this plugin. However, PassPass offers a complete event management solution that eliminates the need for multiple WordPress plugins, payment gateways, and manual event management.
